points.description: Initialisation: arranges weights in the required lattice/topology and initialises them randomly (all different); then samples an input vector from the input space (equivalent wording accepted).
Similarity matching: finds the winning neuron/best matching unit for the input in the lattice (e.g. minimum distance).
Updates weights of the winning neuron and its neighbours using the neighbourhood function (and learning rate).
Reduces neighbourhood radius and decays learning rate; loops back to sampling until ordering/convergence is complete, then stops.
